WITH grouped_data AS (
    SELECT 
        ili.order_item_id,
        p.product_color,
        AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as avg_units_invoiced,
        AVG((ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) / ili.derived_total_cost) as avg_calculated_ratio
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
    INNER JOIN Order_Items oi ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
    INNER JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, p.product_color
),
ranked_data AS (
    SELECT 
        order_item_id,
        product_color,
        avg_units_invoiced,
        avg_calculated_ratio,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_color ORDER BY avg_units_invoiced DESC NULLS LAST) as rank
    FROM grouped_data
)
SELECT 
    order_item_id,
    product_color,
    avg_units_invoiced,
    avg_calculated_ratio,
    rank
FROM ranked_data
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY product_color, rank
